031/**
032 * Example experiments.
033 *
034 * <p>
035 * This enum captures a set of example experiments that can be run via the
036 * {@link io.github.ai4ci.example.RunExampleSim}. Each experiment is defined by
037 * an {@link ImmutableExperimentConfiguration} that specifies the batch, setup
038 * and execution configuration, and any facets. These configurations are used by
039 * the runner to execute the experiment and generate results.
040 *
041 * <p>
042 * Downstream uses include example code and tests that rely on these
043 * configurations as compact baselines. The default experiment is used in
044 * several places as a simple baseline.
045 *
046 * @author Rob Challen
047 */
048public enum Experiment {
049
050        /**
051         * A simple default experiment.
052         *
053         * <p>
054         * This experiment provides a compact configuration that can be used as a
055         * simple baseline in examples and tests. It uses the default batch, setup
056         * and execution configurations, and does not include any facets. Downstream
057         * callers that rely on this simple default include example code and tests.
058         */
059        DEFAULT(
060                        "default",
061                        ExperimentConfiguration.DEFAULT.withExecutionConfig(
062                                ExecutionConfiguration.DEFAULT
063                                        .withDefaultPolicyModelName(NoControl.class.getSimpleName())
064                                        .withDefaultBehaviourModelName(
065                                                NonCompliant.class.getSimpleName()
066                                        )
067                                        .withImportationProbability(0D)
068                                        .withInHostConfiguration(PhenomenologicalModel.DEFAULT)
069                        )
070        ),
071

453
454        /**
455         * Name and configuration for the experiment.
456         *
457         * <p>
458         * These fields are used by the runner to execute the experiment and generate
459         * results. The name is used in the urn base and output paths, and the
460         * configuration specifies the batch, setup and execution configuration, and
461         * any facets.
462         */
463        public String name;
464
465        /**
466         * The experiment configuration specifying the batch, setup and execution
467         * configuration, and any facets. This is used by the runner to execute the
468         * experiment and generate results.
469         */
470        public ImmutableExperimentConfiguration config;
471
472        Experiment(String name, ImmutableExperimentConfiguration config) {
473                this.name = name;
474                this.config = config;
475        }
